description: Minimum printable stroke width for high-density dial features.
sourceNote: Compiled from publicly published custom dial print capability ranges (supplier category aggregate).
rationale: Fine strokes can close up during transfer and curing.
defaultRecommendation: Increase line width or reduce tertiary tick density.

description: Minimum production text height for reliable legibility.
sourceNote: Derived from public minimum-text guidance across custom dial providers.
rationale: Small text fills in and loses edge detail.
defaultRecommendation: Increase text height or shorten copy.

description: Minimum spacing between printed or lumed markers.
sourceNote: Based on repeatability guidance used in production engineering reviews.
rationale: Insufficient separation reduces legibility and process margin.
defaultRecommendation: Lower marker density or widen chapter ring geometry.

description: Minimum radial clearance around chapter ring print zones.
sourceNote: Cross-supplier review guidance for print registration and assembly visual tolerance.
rationale: Narrow clearances amplify tolerance stack effects.
defaultRecommendation: Increase chapter ring width or band gap.

description: Minimum clearances around applied indices and adjacent print.
sourceNote: Derived from applied furniture placement conventions and adhesive process windows.
rationale: Applied hardware needs glue and placement tolerance margin.
defaultRecommendation: Increase marker spacing or shift to printed markers in dense layouts.

description: Minimum lume feature area for consistent application.
sourceNote: Needs supplier-specific validation due to process/material variance.
rationale: Very small lume pads are difficult to apply consistently.
defaultRecommendation: Use larger marker windows or disable lume for micro-markers.

description: Conservative engraving depth guideline for thin dial blanks.
sourceNote: Public datasets rarely disclose depth limits with full material coupling.
rationale: Excessive depth can reduce stiffness and create burr risk.
defaultRecommendation: Confirm depth with supplier before production release.

description: Kerf compensation requirement for laser-generated features.
sourceNote: Common laser process guidance for small-feature retention.
rationale: Kerf close to feature width collapses edges.
defaultRecommendation: Increase feature width or avoid laser for micro details.

description: UV printing limitations on minimum resolved stroke.
sourceNote: Aggregated from publicly published UV print process limits.
rationale: Under-sized strokes do not transfer consistently.
defaultRecommendation: Increase stroke widths or use a different process.

description: Brass blank thickness guidance for stable dial handling.
sourceNote: Typical guidance for reducing warp and handling risk.
rationale: Thin blanks are sensitive to process loads and handling.
defaultRecommendation: Increase blank thickness or reduce process complexity.

description: Multilayer dial compatibility threshold by supplier capability.
rationale: Layer count drives assembly and tolerance complexity.
defaultRecommendation: Use stepped or multi-level supplier profile for layered dial architecture.
